Pitch in, if you’d like.

The app is free because useful training tools should be within reach. If it helps you and you want to support the work, there are a few ways to do that.

01

Make a contribution

Help cover hosting, maintenance, and the less visible work that keeps a free app dependable.

Contribute via Buy Me a Coffee →
02

Train with me

Coaching is a separate service, but choosing it supports the same work and includes access to any future premium app.

Explore training →
03

Share a workout

Pass a useful workout to someone who might benefit. The app does not need a referral program to grow person to person.

See example workouts →
04

Test the app

Kohlrabi is in beta, and your live testing helps create a great app.

About the beta →
